title: The Private Life of Genghis Khan
author: Douglas Adams
note: conf=0.93; Standalone comic short story (1986), derived from a sketch for the 1975 TV pilot 'Out of the Trees'. Co-written with Graham Chapman, though ISFDB, Goodreads and the EPUB metadata all credit Douglas Adams alone; Chapman should be regarded as co-author. First published in 'The Utterly Utterly Merry Comic Relief Christmas Book' (1986) and later included in some editions of 'The Salmon of Doubt'; also posted on douglasadams.com. SERIES = NULL: although Wowbagger the Infinitely Prolonged (from Hitchhiker's) cameos at the end, ISFDB does NOT assign this title to the Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy series — in its contents listing for 'The Salmon of Doubt' the neighbouring 'Young Zaphod Plays It Safe' carries the [Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy] series tag while this story carries none. A cameo does not make it a series volume, and it has no series number in any source.
